about: Retrieval golden set (T-3.1, RAG §9.1). A retrieved chunk is correct when it is from the gold paper (DOI) and section and its page range overlaps the gold pages. Matching by paper/section/page, not chunk ID, keeps the set valid when chunking changes (T-3.7). Questions were written from the ingested chunk text; style tags: paraphrase = different words from the paper, exact = names a specific term/number, vague, typo.
